Reception: what your child practises

In Reception, Sharpwise has 17 topics in maths and 13 topics in English. Each one is below in plain words, with ideas to try at home.

Reception topics follow the EYFS Early Learning Goals. This page is made from the game's own list of topics, so it changes when the game does.

Play Sharpwise

Maths in Reception

17 topics, grouped by the part of the curriculum each one practises.

EYFS Mathematics: Number (ELG)

Count It
Count objects to 10
Match the Number
Link the numeral with its cardinal value
Quick Dots
Subitise to 5
One More, One Less
Composition to 10
Number Bonds
Bonds to 5 and 10
Adding
Composition, addition to 10
Taking Away
Subtraction facts
Balance the Scales
Composition, equal amounts

Try at home:

  • Count stairs, spoons or steps together, then count backwards, and stop to ask what comes next.
  • Lay out 10 spoons and ask how many more make 10.
  • Add the prices of two snacks in your head, then take one away to check the answer.

EYFS Mathematics: Numerical Patterns (ELG)

More or Fewer
Compare quantities
Taller, Heavier, Holds More
Compare length, weight and capacity
What Comes Next?
Count beyond 20
Order Up!
Compare and order to 10
Pattern Party
Continue repeating patterns
Doubles
Double facts within 10
Share It Out
Distribute equally between two
Partners
Evens and odds

Try at home:

  • Put two heaps of socks or coins side by side and ask which has more, and by how many.
  • Compare a cup, a jug and a bowl: which holds more? Use a ruler or shoe-lengths to measure the table.
  • Count stairs, spoons or steps together, then count backwards, and stop to ask what comes next.
  • Chalk a number line on the path and hop along it, asking where a number sits between two others.
  • Lay out 10 spoons and ask how many more make 10.
  • Share a bowl of grapes fairly between family members and ask how many each, and how many are left.

EYFS Development Matters: Spatial reasoning

Shape Spotter
Circle, square, triangle, rectangle

Try at home:

  • Go on a shape hunt around the house for circles, boxes, cylinders and right angles.

English in Reception

13 topics, grouped by the part of the curriculum each one practises.

EYFS Literacy: Comprehension (ELG)

Story Time
Understanding what has been read to them
Story Order
Anticipate key events in stories

Try at home:

  • After a bedtime story, ask who it was about, what happened and where, then how many or why.

EYFS Literacy: Word Reading (ELG)

Rhyme Time
Spot and suggest rhymes
How Many Beats?
Count or clap syllables in a word
Sound Hunt
Say a sound for each letter; phase 2–3 sounds by ear
Big & Small Letters
Letters
Tricky Words
Common exception words
Read It!
Read words by sound-blending
Starts Like
Words with the same initial sound

Try at home:

  • Take turns thinking of words that rhyme with cat, sun or log, and clap the beats in names.
  • Say a word slowly, sound by sound, and ask your child to blend the sounds back into the word.
  • Read a few lines together every day and ask your child to point to the tricky words.

EYFS Literacy: Writing (ELG)

Letter Sounds
Sounds to letters
Build a Word
Spell by sounds (CVC)
Story Sentences
Simple sentences
Trace Letters
Form letters

Try at home:

  • Say a word slowly, sound by sound, and ask your child to blend the sounds back into the word.
  • Read a few lines together every day and ask your child to point to the tricky words.
  • Write big letters and numbers in flour, sand or with a finger on a steamy window.
